facts.fact: The ministry's contracts list shows an individual consultant contract signed 23/07/2025 under the World Bank-financed WARDIP project, for four months, to upgrade the Agenda national de Transformation Numérique and draft an Agenda 2030; the page describes no scope.
The contract of 1,280,000 MRU to upgrade the Agenda national de Transformation Numérique and draft an Agenda 2030 is listed under WARDIP with IDA as source of financing.
